'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Bob Hiltz LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bob Hiltz]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
